neighbours.label: emphatic ' just' in a flat, dismissive assertion ('It's just not possible', 'That's just how it is')
fire: You can't be in two places at once. It's just not possible.
Nobody finishes that course in a month. That's just how it is.
We can't afford a second car. It's just not going to happen.
He will never apologise to her. That's just the way he is.
You cannot run a farm from a city flat. It's just not possible.
Some days the fish don't bite. That's just how it goes.
They can't fix the roof before winter. There's just no way.
I tried to like the opera. It's just not for me.
quiet: You can't be in two places at once. Pick one and tell them today.
Nobody finishes that course in a month. Most students need a full year.
We can't afford a second car. The bus stops near the house anyway.
He will never apologise to her. His brother wrote the letter instead.
You cannot run a farm from a city flat. She moved out there in March.
Some days the fish don't bite. We pack up early and walk home.
They can't fix the roof before winter. The builders are booked until May.
I tried to like the opera. My sister bought the tickets for us.

notes: Card: peaks ' What' x7 (rhetorical questions), ' think' x3, what, how, just, been, why; the + pole is 'consider / possibility' (entertaining an idea), so this pole may be the opposite stance: refusing to entertain it. Probes were weak: 'It's just not possible' 0.22, 'That's just how it is' 0.35, 'It's just not realistic' 0.13, rhetorical 'What ...?' 0.04-0.08, 'why spend' 0.18. Best guess only; likely to fail.
